title: Raster School — Precise Swiss Modern Course Site

logo.specs: SVG; dark and light versions; square symbol for favicon. Until the owner’s own exists: the name set as a wordmark in the display face, and its first letter as the favicon — no invented symbol to throw away later
logo.note: Wordmark set in Zalando Sans 800 (components/site/Logo.tsx); favicon is the letter R (src/app/icon.svg). Replace when the owner’s logo exists.

typefaces.note: Zalando Sans via next/font/google (variable, wght + wdth).

finalCopy.specs: Written in the recipe voice before layout; headlines ≤ 8 words
finalCopy.note: Written in src/content/. Every invented fact (prices, dates, names, quotes, address) is marked PLACEHOLDER there.

finalHeadlineCopy.specs: Short: 3–8 words each; written before layout

team.specs: 4 files · 1:1 · 2000×2000 — one portrait per person, in the same light and framing, ideally where they work
team.note: The owner's photos, 2000×2000 black and white portraits. Alt text per file in src/config/assets.ts.

about.specs: 1 file · 4:3 · 2400×1800 — a real portrait of the person or the team, in their own place
about.note: The owner's photo, 2400×1800 black and white: hands inking a letterpress forme with a roller.
